params.body:
## What Shane saw

On the stocklist detail page (phone, same on desktop): open "Voorstellen aan relatie", pick a relation, press "Voorstellen", and nothing happens on screen. No notification, no confirmation, no error. "nadat ik voorgesteld heb aan relatie is er geen melding".

## What actually happened

Reproduced in a running application with an own database, console and network captured. The submit did leave: the modal was a plain form POST, `POST /vehicles/{id}/propose` answered a 302 back to the detail page, the row was in `vehicle_proposals` and the mail was rendered (to the log outside production). The controller put "Voorstel opgeslagen en gemaild naar ..." in the session as `message`, and that was the end of it: `stocklist/detail.blade.php` does not include `layouts/toast`, the only thing that turns a flash message into a `ui.notify`. The page reloaded, the modal was gone because the page was gone, and the sentence stayed in the session. Same silence as the Car-Pass request and the buy-over (X-126): an action that reaches a third party with a screen that says nothing.

Nothing stopped the second click either: the button stayed live while the synchronous mail was sent, and the server accepted the same proposal as often as it came. A relation without an e-mail address (some were entered with only a phone number) was logged with `mailed = 0` and reported as saved while the customer got nothing. A mail failure turned the whole answer into an error page while the row already existed.

## What the dealer now sees

Following the buy-over precedent (PR 354) on the same page: the modal submits over ajax and paints the outcome itself; the route answers JSON on ajax and a redirect with the same sentence as flash message on a plain navigation.

- Success: the modal closes, a notify says "Voorstel gestuurd naar <display name>." (display name, so a company without contact person has a name too).
- Refusal: a red notify with the reason, the modal stays open so another relation can be chosen. "Kies eerst een relatie.", "Ongeldige relatie geselecteerd.", "<naam> heeft geen e-mailadres. Vul het eerst aan bij de relatie, dan kan het voorstel gemaild worden." (nothing is stored), "Het voorstel kon niet gemaild worden naar <naam>. Probeer het zo opnieuw." (row stays with `mailed = 0`, retry possible at once).
- The submit button is disabled before the request leaves and only comes back after a refusal; without an answer it stays dead and the message says to refresh first, because the mail may have left.
- Second submit: the server refuses the same vehicle to the same relation within sixty seconds with "Dit voorstel is net al gestuurd naar <naam>." (422), via a cache lock for requests that arrive together and the database for the click after the first one answered. Measured in the browser with a delayed POST: two clicks plus a `requestSubmit` during the send gave one POST and one mail; reopening the modal and proposing again gave the refusal. After the minute the same proposal is a reminder and goes through.

The relation picker in this modal is the inline searchable combobox over the dealer's relations (display name plus e-mail/phone as sub-line), not the `relationModal` picker of the offer and order modals; it is unchanged and renders correctly at 390px.

## Rules and finding

R S4-2.16 and R S4-2.17 added, R S4-2.14 adjusted (a proposal to a relation without an address is no longer logged; if Ilse wants that logged as a note, that is a separate decision, noted in the finding). Finding recorded as `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-15-voorstel-zegt-niets.md` (new one-file-per-finding format). Route comment in `routes/_partials/Vehicle.php` brought up to date.

## Tests

`VehicleProposalTest` rewritten around the new contract (9 tests, `@rule S4-2.14` to `S4-2.17`): the stored row and the rendered mail to the right address with the right subject and body, the sentence with the display name (also for a company), the refusals with status and sentence, nothing stored for a relation without e-mail, one mail for a repeat within the minute and a second one after it, and the flash message on a plain POST. Mail is rendered, never sent.

`vendor/bin/phpunit --filter 'Propose|Proposal|Relation|Stocklist|HandlerWiring|AlpineExpression|RulesCoverage|CompiledViews|StylesheetSyntax'`: OK, 84 tests, 795 assertions, 1 skipped (pre-existing).
params.title: Proposing a vehicle to a relation showed nothing
